bs-hn.label: Small-sample hot seasons with a following season of at least 60 balls
bs-hn.dataset: CricField warehouse: Cricsheet IPL ball-by-ball data, 2008–2026
bs-hn.query: SELECT pl.name, CAST(CASE m.season_id WHEN '2007/08' THEN '2008' WHEN '2009/10' THEN '2010' WHEN '2020/21' THEN '2020' ELSE m.season_id END AS INTEGER) year, MAX(CASE WHEN i.batting_team_id IN (13) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) mine, SUM(d.batter_runs) runs, SUM(CASE WHEN d.is_wide = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) balls FROM deliveries d JOIN innings i ON i.innings_id = d.innings_id JOIN matches m ON m.match_id = d.match_id JOIN players pl ON pl.player_id = d.batter_id WHERE i.innings_number <= 2 GROUP BY pl.name, year
